name: AgentPulse
intent: Animated brand-coloured indicator that visualises the four canonical agent states (idle, listening, thinking, speaking) using the OneUI logo geometry. Recolours per brand and adapts on coloured surfaces.

name: Avatar
intent: Display a user or entity representation as image, icon, or text initials.

name: Badge
intent: Non-interactive display component used to highlight status, provide notifications, or categorize content. Supports start/end slots for icons and sub-badges.

name: BottomNavigation
intent: Primary mobile-app navigation landmark for 2–5 top-level destinations. Product code supplies BottomNavItem children; the parent owns one controlled or uncontrolled current value and renders a horizontal Base UI toolbar inside <nav>.

name: BottomNavItem
intent: One button or link destination inside BottomNavigation. The parent normally owns the singular current value; explicit active remains a standalone and compatibility escape hatch.

name: Breadcrumb
intent: Ordered hierarchy navigation with semantic links, plain-text current page, optional home icon, count-based overflow menu, and measurement-gated truncation tooltips.

name: Button
intent: Trigger a single user action with clear emphasis and accessible states.

name: Carousel
intent: Multi-brand carousel micropattern. Compound API (`Carousel.Root` / `Viewport` / `Track` / `Slide` / controls) with thin design-variant presets (`Carousel.Desktop`, `Carousel.Tablet`, `Carousel.Mobile`). Slides layer image, scrim, content (badge / headline / body / actions), and corner slots. Surface-context-aware. Web engine: Embla Carousel. Figma-aligned API: `followsAspectRatio`, 1-based `activePage` / `pageCount`.

name: Checkbox
intent: Binary selection control for forms and settings with tri-state (indeterminate) support.

name: CheckboxField
intent: `Field.Root` + **Checkbox** with integrated `Field.Label` / `Field.Description`, optional `infoIconSlot`, `error` / `feedback`, and native `Field.Error` slot — same composition contract as **InputField** (Figma `.DNA/InputField` stack; control DNA from Checkbox). Colour follows `appearance` on the inner Checkbox.

name: Chip
intent: Compact interactive label for filtering, tagging, or selecting values.

name: ChipGroup
intent: Groups multiple Chip components with shared selection state, keyboard navigation, and layout. Supports single-select (default) and multi-select modes. Propagates size, attention, and appearance to all child Chips.

name: CircularProgressIndicator
intent: Circular progress arc. Determinate variant renders an arc proportional to `value`; indeterminate renders a spinning animation. Optional center content (icon or auto percentage). 10 t-shirt sizes. Multi-accent appearance roles.

name: Container
intent: Page-width shell (`fluid` / `fixed` / `full-bleed`) and declarative layout root. On web the node is always `<Surface>` (default `surface="ghost"`) so children get `[data-surface]` token context without an opaque page fill. Omit `layout` for normal block flow; set `layout` to `flex` or `grid` for token-backed flex/grid. Spacing props use spacing scale keys, not raw px.

name: CounterBadge
intent: Non-interactive display component showing a numeric count with bold/subtle/ghost variants and multi-accent support.

name: Divider
intent: Visual separator between sections, list items, or content groups.

name: Icon
intent: Render a semantic or custom icon with configurable size, colour role, and emphasis level.

name: IconButton
intent: Trigger compact single actions with icon-only affordance.

name: IconContained
intent: Display an icon within a filled container shape with attention-level emphasis.

name: Image
intent: Display an image with aspect ratio presets, loading states, and optional interactive overlay.

name: IndicatorBadge
intent: Non-interactive status/presence indicator dot. Supports multi-accent appearance roles and five sizes.

name: InputField
intent: Text input field: `Field.Root` + **Input** (`Field.Label` / `Field.Description` for label-stack copy, `Field.Control` for the `<input>`, 4-slot shell), then `InputFeedback` (including native `Field.Error` when there is no string `error` / custom `feedback`), and DynamicText. Default info uses `IconButton` + `Tooltip` (override with `infoIconSlot`). Optional `labelSlot` replaces string `label` / `description`.

name: LinearProgressIndicator
intent: Horizontal progress bar for determinate (value-driven) or indeterminate loading. Three sizes (S/M/L), pill or flat caps, and multi-accent appearance roles.

name: Logo
intent: A visual mark that identifies and reinforces brand identity throughout the interface. Transparent size container — the SVG content controls its own shape and colors. Inside a BrandProvider, `<Logo alt="…" />` renders the active brand's logo automatically; pass children / svgContent / src only to override it.

name: Modal
intent: Focused overlay with structured header/body/footer layout and scroll management. The modal popup is role-neutral; per-role styling is applied to the slot children (footer buttons, headerStart, body content).

name: Pagination
intent: Composite page navigator with backward-compatible numbered `truncate` and selectable `compact` treatments. Compact composes the existing Select menu, displays `current / total`, and supports previous/next plus optional first/last controls. Uncontrolled by default (`defaultPage`); pass `page` + `onPageChange` for controlled mode. Includes a WAI-ARIA navigation landmark, keyboard support, selected-option semantics, and a polite live region.

name: PaginationDots
intent: Sliding-conveyor pagination indicator for carousels and multi-page content. All N dots render inside a CSS-translating track; the active pill stays at the viewport centre when possible and walks toward the boundary near the start / end. Off-viewport dots collapse to 0 × 0 and scale up to edge (4px) as the conveyor slides them in, then back to 0 on exit — no pop-clip. Loop mode wraps last → first under --Motion-Duration-XL; every other advance runs at --Motion-Duration-L. CSS-only motion. Fully accessible: roving tabindex, keyboard nav, aria-selected.

name: PrimaryNav
intent: Primary HeaderWeb row. Figma publishes homeBar, contextBar, and searchBar types with fluid or centered middle content.

name: Radio
intent: Single-selection control within a mutually-exclusive option group.

name: RadioField
intent: `Field.Root` + **RadioGroup** with optional `Field.Label` / `Field.Description`, `infoIconSlot`, `error` / `feedback`, and native `Field.Error` slot — same shell as **InputField** / **CheckboxField**. Integrated single mode has no `Radio` children; colour follows **`appearance`** on inner radios.

name: Scrim
intent: Non-interactive overlay for media legibility (directional gradient) or modal backdrops (uniform fill). Matches the position, size, attention, variant, and overlay blur axes from Figma.

name: SegmentedControl
intent: Mutually exclusive segmented control for switching between related views or filters. Wraps Base UI ToggleGroup. Supports track emphasis, attention-driven selected states, equal-width layout, text and icon-only segments, and start (icon) / end (CounterBadge) slots.

name: Select
intent: Choose one or many values, or invoke an action, through a composed input, button, or icon-button trigger and an anchored menu.

name: SelectableButton
intent: Toggle button with text label and optional start/end slots for binary selection within groups.

name: SelectableIconButton
intent: Icon-only toggle button for compact binary selection with configurable shape layout.

name: SelectableSingleTextButton
intent: Text-only toggle button for binary selection — no start/end slots, simpler than SelectableButton.

name: SingleTextButton
intent: Circular single-text action button (max 2 characters, e.g. "Ag", "En"). Attention level drives the visual: high=bold fill, medium=subtle fill, low=ghost. 3 sizes (S/M/L). Shape customisable per brand.

name: Skeleton
intent: PRD-derived loading placeholder primitives. Compose SkeletonItem blocks inside SkeletonGroup for automatic shimmer stagger. No canonical OneUI Figma component is currently published.

name: Slider
intent: Precision range input with s/m/l geometry, continuous/range types, inside/outside knob styles, optional step ticks, and a value tooltip that follows the thumb.

name: Stepper
intent: Numeric input control with increment and decrement buttons for bounded integer values.

name: Surface
intent: Container primitive that opts descendants into the OneUI surface cascade via [data-surface]. The `mode` prop maps to one of the 8 canonical surface tokens (default/ghost/minimal/subtle/moderate/bold/elevated/blend). Optional transparent material composites over arbitrary media.

name: Switch
intent: Immediate binary toggle — state takes effect on change without a submit action.

name: Tabs
intent: Accessible tabbed navigation on Base UI Tabs. Figma node 1:55592: inactive labels use content/low (`--Text-Low`), selected labels use content/high (`--Text-High`), accent is the indicator bar only (`--Primary-Tinted` / colour/content/tinted). Not TintedA11y on labels.

name: Text
intent: Inline / block text. Six typography roles with role-specific size scales, canonical multi-accent appearance, attention levels, italic / underline / strikethrough, latin / multi-script font fallback, and line-clamp truncation. Defaults to `span`; set `as` for headings or anchors. When using the `text` prop with the `link` slot, avoid `aria-hidden` on the root unless the link is decorative — the slot remains focusable.

name: Toast
intent: Transient status feedback with semantic type, independent visual attention and announcement priority, optional action content, progress, stacking, dedupe, and promise lifecycle.

name: Tooltip
intent: Floating label that attaches to a trigger element. The canonical API follows Figma: position, tip, disable, delay, hideDelay, offset, and portal; deprecated Base UI-style aliases remain compatible.

name: TouchSlider
intent: Chunky 160×32 fingertip-friendly slider. The track is the tap target; the fill represents the value. Ideal for touch devices, TV remotes, and large-target contexts.

name: WebHeader
intent: Figma HeaderWeb root. Composes PrimaryNav and an optional SecondaryNav on a neutral default Surface; the root owns the two divider defaults.
